title: Code and derived data for: Do stratospheric and recurrent Rossby-wave precursors control persistent cold spells over Bangladesh? Evidence from 40 winters, 1985/86-2024/25
description: Analysis code, frozen analysis policies, cold-night and cold-day spell catalogues, ERA5-derived daily series, and all result tables and figures of the article. BMD station observations are not included; they were obtained from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department on request and may not be redistributed.
